sources.metadata: MacKinnon, James G.; White, Halbert (1985). Journal of Econometrics 29(3):305-325. DOI10.1016/0304-4076(85)90158-7. Author-hosted working paper includes later updated references; cited equations independently inspected.

sources.scope: Modern self-contained proof; not claimed to be the seminal historical introduction of OLS.

source_evidence.locator: MacKinnonWhite1985 Section2 equations(1)-(3),p2; Stepniak2010 Theorem3.2,p3 and Theorem4.1,p4
source_evidence.scope: Full-column-rank unweighted OLS target beta_hat=(X^T X)^(-1)X^T y under a linear model with mean-zero errors; normal equations and Gauss-Markov result under spherical covariance. Source-to-estimator-definition correspondence only; no proof of STATADIC QR factorization, IEEE behavior, deficient-rank extension or all inferential references.

Unweighted full-rank OLS only: estimated sampling covariance RSS/(n-p)*(X^T X)^(-1), matching native classical_covariance with all relative precisions1 and extra multiplier1. Assumes independent homoskedastic errors for its classical interpretation. Exact finite t/F references require fixed X and Gaussian errors and remain separate reference decisions. Does not separately review arbitrary finite_sample_correction or weighted-precision extension.

correction_proposals.corrected_evidence: MacKinnonWhite1985 original jackknife HC3 includes BOTH prefactor(n-1)/n and recentering subtraction(n-1)/n^2 gamma gamma^T, gamma=(X^T X)^(-1)X^T u*, u*_i=u_i/(1-h_i). STATADIC conventional HC3 instead uses the uncentered sandwich with squared leverage denominators and default multiplier1. The leverage adjustment and asymptotic relationship are reviewed; equality to the original finite-sample centered jackknife is not established. A later primary exact conventional formula is needed before approving that full variant. Reference distributions and weighted-OLS extensions are separate.

blocked_proposals.blocker: Stepniak2010 specifies spherical covariance; whitening yields a clear mathematical specialization, but this wave did not review a primary explicit analytic-precision WLS formula, variance-scale normalization or Aitken original. Do not extend unweighted source approval automatically.

MacKinnonWhite1985 Section3 uses normal critical values in simulations, not universal exact normal calibration with estimated scale. Retain unresolved until a bounded reference-formula approval is distinguished from validity across arbitrary fitted uncertainty carriers.

MacKinnonWhite1985 Section2 states exact fixed-X Gaussian t/F inference, but a generic carrier-level variant covers more than classical OLS. Student1908 mean-only result does not by itself approve arbitrary regression/robust covariance. Need explicit bound to classical Gaussian OLS and independently inspected inversion formula/df mapping.

Exact multi-restriction numerator rank/denominator residual-df formula not independently read in a primary full text in this wave; general exact t/F mention insufficient for blanket shared-provider approval.
General Wald covariance consistency/CLT and full-row-rank assumptions require their own source review; no blanket inference from OLS point definition.
